messages:
marta: FYI seeing repeated latency spikes on eu-west nodes; looks correlated with NIC tx-queue collisions when two tenants burst GPU-side traffic. short logs below.
ryan: can you paste the `ss -tin` or `ethtool -S` dump? curious if IRQs are spiking.
marta: pasted snippet:
```
May 26 11:08:12 node-42 kernel: net_tx_queue(3) overflow tenant=team-alpha pid=4832
May 26 11:08:12 node-42 kernel: net_tx_queue(4) collision tenant=team-beta pid=9121
May 26 11:08:13 node-42 tc: qdisc pfifo_fast dropped 256 pkts
```
ryan: ugh. sounds like kernel queue contention + default qdisc starvation. did we recently enable GPUDirect on these racks?
devon: we did on eu-west-rack-3 last week for perf testing. that can increase PCIe bursts => NIC backlog. Could try `tc netem` shaping per-tenant egress to smooth bursts.
sophia: can we move high-throughput jobs to dedicated slices temporarily? those noisy tenants are on shared pools.
marta: cost concern: moving 2 tenants to dedicated raises monthly commit by ~1.6k for the rack. Worth it short-term?
ryan: do a quick cost-check: `dedicated-slice-hourly * hours` — but also downstream SLO hits are expensive. vote: short-term dedicate the worst offender, shape the rest.
devon: proposing a two-step plan:
1) apply per-tenant `tc` policer on top of netdev (burst=50kb, rate=200mbit) — quick rollback
2) schedule dedicated-slice for team-beta for 24h to observe if spikes stop
3) longer-term: kernel tuning + IRQ affinity to isolate rx/tx queues
infra-bot: ALERT: egress-flap detected on node-42 (eu-west-rack-3). correlated incidents=3 in last 6h. ticket=#INC-3487
sophia: assigning owners: ryan -> apply tc policer (now), marta -> cost + slice request, devon -> kernel irq affinity patch draft
marta: ok will open PR for slice request and ping finance. I'll mark `inc-3487` and update if cost ok.
ryan: I applied a conservative policer to dev on node-42, monitoring now. :eyes:
devon: capturing perf counters and will post `/tmp/queue-stats.log` shortly.
sophia: if policer works we can automate suggested settings in Optimize as a temporary rule for shared pools.
marta: great. if policer doesn't help we'll flip to dedicate. thanks all.
